title: github-pr-explorer settings
description: settings.json in the configuration folder (~/Library/Application Support/github-pr-explorer/config). The app's Settings window writes this file, and the app applies a change as soon as the file is saved. Only formatVersion is required: a key left out takes its default. A key not listed here makes the file invalid, and the app keeps using the last version that worked.

$schema.description: Optional. A link to this schema, for editors. The app ignores it.

formatVersion.description: The version of this file's format. This app reads version 1 only.

appearance.description: Light, dark, or whatever the system uses. Default: system.

defaultLayout.description: The id of the layout every pull request page opens with: a built-in layout (decision-first, tabbed) or the id of a file in layouts/. When no layout has this id, Decision first is used and the problem is reported. The layout menu in the window changes the open window only. Default: decision-first.

hidesBotEventsInActivity.description: When true, the Activity block starts with events from bots folded into one row that can be opened. Default: true.

experiments.description: Features being tried, by name, each true for on. One left out is off. A name the app does not know makes the file invalid. There are no experiments right now, so this is {}.
